watch.en: Proof in a warm place until the dough has doubled and springs back lightly when touched.
watch.de: An einem warmen Ort gehen lassen, bis sich der Teig verdoppelt hat und beim Antippen leicht zurückfedert.

why.en: Covering the dough keeps air from forming a skin or crust on it.
why.de: Abgedeckt bildet sich an der Luft keine Haut und keine Kruste auf dem Teig.

sources.title: Introduction to Baking and Pastries (Rink and Thibodeaux)
sources.sentence: The dough should double in volume and spring back lightly when touched.

sources.title: Introduction to Baking and Pastries (Rink and Thibodeaux)
sources.sentence: This occurs in two ways: proof box or in a warm dry place.

sources.title: Introduction to Baking and Pastries (Rink and Thibodeaux)
sources.sentence: The dough is covered during this time to avoid air hitting it and forming a “skin” or crust
